capabilities: Launch the Hermes Agent CLI in an embedded PTY terminal
Share selected or cursor note context with Hermes via a per-tab JSON bridge
Show busy/idle status per Hermes tab and notify when background turns finish
Manage multiple terminal tabs with rename, colors, pinning, and reordering
Insert vault note wiki-links and dragged file paths into the terminal
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; native node-pty binaries must be downloaded from plugin settings after install, and the README includes ARM64 Windows troubleshooting. A donation link is included.
intentEvidence: Hermes Console began as a fork of Lean Terminal, an open-source terminal plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run the Hermes Agent alongside notes or pass selected note text as context without switching to an external terminal.

relations.evidence: Hermes Console began as a fork of Lean Terminal, an open-source terminal plugin for Obsidian.
Launch Hermes from your vault, opt in per terminal tab to share selected note text

summary: Embedded terminal that launches the Hermes Agent CLI from the vault and shares selected note text with it through a local JSON bridge.
